newsitem.title: UK: Dawn Til Dusk comes to AIM with 4.04 million tag.
newsitem.headline: Dawn Til Dusk comes to AIM with 4.04 million tag.

text.p: Dawn Til Dusk Plc said on Tuesday it planned to float at 115p on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM), valuing the retailer at 4.04 million stg.
"The fund raising and admission to AIM provides a flexible means of funding our further growth," said chairman Stephen Hartley.
"We are now well placed to consolidate our position in the north west, and to look further afield for expansion opportunities"
The placing, sponsored by Butterfield Securities, raised 1.5 million stg. Trading in the shares will begin on November 29.
